2609.04906.title: Methane Detection On Board Satellites from Unorthorectified Imagery
2609.04906.paper_summary: As a potent greenhouse gas, methane is a major driver of climate change. Its effective mitigation relies on timely detection. Conventional detection methods rely on orthorectification to correct geometric distortions and matched filters to enhance plume signals, which are steps designed for ground processing and poorly suited to onboard execution. We introduce UnorthoDOS, a dataset and approach for training machine learning models directly on unorthorectified hyperspectral imagery, bypassing both orthorectification and matched-filter products. Our U-Net models trained on unorthorectified data approach the performance of models trained on orthorectified data (IoU 16.91% vs. 18.47% on all plumes), while both substantially outperform the mag1c matched-filter baseline (IoU 4.76%). We further demonstrate the feasibility of onboard deployment: FP16 compression halves model size with under 0.3% output deviation. The trained ML models and two ML-ready datasets -- orthorectified and unorthorectified hyperspectral imagery from the EMIT sensor -- are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SpaceML/UnorthoDOS, with code at https://github.com/spaceml-org/plume-hunter.
2609.04906.paper_summary_zh: 作為一種強效的溫室氣體，甲烷是氣候變化的主要驅動因素。其有效的減緩依賴於及時的檢測。傳統的檢測方法依賴於正射校正來修正幾何失真，並使用匹配濾波器來增強煙霧信號，這些步驟是為了地面處理而設計的，並不適合在機載執行。我們介紹了UnorthoDOS，一個數據集和方法，用於直接在未正射校正的高光譜影像上訓練機器學習模型，繞過正射校正和匹配濾波產品。我們在未正射校正數據上訓練的U-Net模型接近於在正射校正數據上訓練的模型的性能（所有煙霧的IoU為16.91%對18.47%），而且兩者都大幅超越了mag1c匹配濾波基線（IoU 4.76%）。我們進一步展示了機載部署的可行性：FP16壓縮將模型大小減半，輸出偏差低於0.3%。訓練好的機器學習模型和兩個機器學習準備好的數據集——來自EMIT傳感器的正射校正和未正射校正的高光譜影像——已在https://huggingface.co/datasets/SpaceML/UnorthoDOS公開提供，代碼在https://github.com/spaceml-org/plume-hunter。
